newsitem.title: GERMANY: German fourth beet test has 9.71 T/ha sugar yield.
newsitem.headline: German fourth beet test has 9.71 T/ha sugar yield.

text.p: The fourth German sugar beet test of the 1996/97 campaign showed a sugar yield of 9.71 tonnes per hectare compared with 8.79 tonnes in the fourth test of 1995/96, the sugar industry association WVZ said on Monday.

The test also showed an average sugar content of 16.8 percent compared with 15.8 percent in the fourth 1995 test and 15.3 percent in the third 1996 test taken a fortnight ago, when the sugar yield was 7.81 tonnes/ha.
The fourth 1996 test was taken last Friday, September 13, and last year's fourth test was taken on September 15, 1995.
